summary: When a family moves, the school follows the new address, and the district has to be told.
realLife: Families who move are told to update their address with the district; families who want a different school can apply to a choice program.
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (move/moved-in, then school/started at the new place). needs: a school change tied to the move record.
